remarks:
Welcome to Spice Creek! With over 2,800 sq ft of living space PLUS a finished basement, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers an impressive amount of space inside and out. The main level features a spacious living room with fireplace, luxury vinyl flooring, a well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances, formal dining room, first-floor laundry and convenient half bath. Upstairs, the primary suite is a retreat of its own with a tray ceiling, private ensuite and walk-in closet. The additional full bath has been completely remodeled, while new carpeting gives the second floor a fresh feel. The oversized 4th bedroom is a standout, offering the flexibility to serve as a bedroom, home office, rec room or bonus space, with direct access to a covered composite balcony. Step outside and you’ll see what makes this property even more special—a mature, private backyard with no rear neighbors, once featured on a natural garden and habitat tour. The finished basement adds even more room to gather, entertain or unwind. All major mechanics have been updated within the past 4 years, taking care of many of the big-ticket items. An attached 2-car garage and covered front porch round out the home. Located in the desirable Spice Creek neighborhood within the Niagara Wheatfield School District, you’ll enjoy a quiet neighborhood setting while still being conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks and everyday amenities, with easy access to Niagara Falls Blvd and the surrounding Northtowns. Nearly 3,000 sq ft above grade, additional finished space below, thoughtful updates and a backyard that truly sets it apart.
